record.reason: Full text presents AbstentionBench as an evaluation benchmark for whether LLMs decline unanswerable questions and reports reasoning fine-tuning effects on abstention. It does not propose dynamic early exit, adaptive token computation, or inference-resource savings; the conditional-computation lineage is not technically connected.
record.title: AbstentionBench: Reasoning LLMs Fail on Unanswerable Questions
